title: Austin Leaders Retreat: Vision & Budget Focus
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders engaged in a two-day off-site retreat dedicated to strengthening working relationships among Councilmembers and city staff.
*   Key discussions focused on establishing shared goals, fostering an integrated vision for the city, and improving communication protocols.
*   Attendees also reviewed the municipal budget process and identified government priorities, though no final policy decisions or actions were taken during the retreat.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
LCRA RIVERSIDE CONFERENCE CENTER
1405 WILLOW, BASTROP, TEXAS
JUNE 27,1997
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order at 1:00 p.m. then introduced Mr. Mel Waxier, who
was the facilitator for the meeting.
1.
The purpose of the meeting was to conduct exercises to build working relationships among
Councilmembers and with City staff; discuss the municipal budget and the municipal budget
process; identify priorities for City government; and discuss procedures and protocols for
communication between and among Councilmembers and City staff. No final action will be
taken.
Mr. Waxier outlined the following goals for the retreat: build upon existing relationships
between and among Council and Staff allow Council and Staff to share information create an
integrated vision of the Council which incorporates specific individual Councilmember
priorities/projects and moves the budget process forward in a meaningful way construct
effective and trust building processes between and among Council and Staff which will
further the Council vision, Member priorities, Staff service, and Public confidence
produce positive results
The following people assisted Mr. Waxier with his presentation: Marc Dominus, Steve Plante
and Rosie Jalifi.
Most of the meeting focused on building strong and effective relationships. 2.
ADJOURNED at 9:15 p.m.
Approved on this the 10th day of July, 1997 on, Councilmember Spelman's motion, Mayor Pro
Tern Garcia's second, 7-0 vote.

1405 WILLOW, BASTROP, TEXAS
JUNE 28,1997

Approved on this the 10th day of July, 1997 on, Councilmember Spelman's motion, Mayor Pro
Tern
